name: PrecedentKnowledgeBank
tagline: A governed precedent bank for law firms and in-house legal teams – search, approve, review and keep every precedent current in one Power Apps control.
description: Full-app PCF component for knowledge teams: a fee-earner library with relevance search, facets and tags; an approval board with four-eyes partner approval and versioning; currency reviews with review cycles, warning days and law-change alerts; restricted-use control, usage counts and ratings. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Relevance search with facets (type, practice area, jurisdiction, currency) and popular tags
Approval workflow: Draft, In review, Changes requested, Published, Under revision, Withdrawn, Archived – allowed transitions only
Four-eyes rule and approved-partner list for publishing
Automatic version bump when a revision returns to review
Currency reviews with default or per-precedent cycles and warning days
Law-change alerts with recorded assessment (no change or start revision)
Restricted precedents with partner sign-off confirmation and optional hiding
Use precedent opens the document and counts the use; ratings and most-used analytics
Bulk assign owner, set review cycle, confirm current; CSV export; undo
Demo mode, phone layout with bottom bar, keyboard and ARIA support
